findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice long questions for Unit 8 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 30 questions numbered 1-30; by section: 8.1 6, 8.1.1 3, 8.1.2 1, 8.2 3, 8.2.1 2, 8.2.2 2, 8.3 2, 8.3.1 5, 8.4 1, 8.5.1 3, 8.6 2.

Induction proofs (sums, divisibility, extended induction for inequalities, a real-life count), the proof of the binomial theorem, general term problems, middle and constant terms, deductions on binomial coefficients, negative and fractional index (general term, expansions, roots, approximations, summing a series, coefficient of x^n), Pascal's triangle, remainders and divisibility, compound interest and a stock recurrence. New statements and numbers; no exercise question or book example repeated. Book corrections followed ((a + x)^(k+1) in (D); the stock formula is the correct L + (I0 - L)a^n form). Every step was checked by computation (sympy).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
